INTERVAL 1 DAY AND paid_at < CURDATE()) AS yesterdayMemberOpens, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND paid_at >= CURDATE()) AS todayRevenue

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at < #{start}) AS userBase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kitchen WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at < #{start}) AS kitchenBase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at < #{start}) AS dishBase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at < #{start}) AS orderBase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cook_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at < #{start}) AS reviewBase, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND paid_at < #{start}) AS memberOpenBase, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND paid_at < #{start}) AS revenueBase

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS num, SUM(CASE WHEN inviter_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invitedNum, SUM(CASE WHEN inviter_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalNum FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS num FROM user_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, HOUR(created_at) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS num FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at), HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY dt, hr

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, HOUR(created_at) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS num FROM user_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at), HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY dt, hr
SELECT CASE sex WHEN 0 THEN '女' WHEN 1 THEN '男' ELSE '未知' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS num FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex
SELECT id, nickname AS nickname, invite_count AS inviteCount FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND invite_count > 0 ORDER BY invite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(l.created_at)) AS num FROM user_login_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.created_at >= #{start} AND l.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY l.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY num DESC, l.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(*) AS num FROM user_login_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.created_at >= #{start} AND l.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY l.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY num DESC, l.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, MAX(t.dayCount) AS num FROM ( SELECT l.user_id AS user_id, DATE(l.created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS dayCount FROM user_login_log l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.created_at >= #{start} AND l.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY l.user_id, DATE(l.created_at) ) t LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.user_id GROUP BY t.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY num DESC, t.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kitchen WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalKitchens, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kitchen WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS newKitchens
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS num FROM kitchen WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT member_count AS memberCount, COUNT(*) AS num FROM ( SELECT k.id, COUNT(ku.id) AS member_count FROM kitchen k LEFT JOIN kitchen__user ku ON ku.kitchen_id = k.id AND ku.deleted = 0 WHERE k.deleted = 0 GROUP BY k.id ) t GROUP BY member_count ORDER BY member_count

SELECT k.id AS id, k.name AS name, u.nickname AS owner, COUNT(d.id) AS dishCount FROM kitchen k JOIN `user` u ON u.id = k.owner_id LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.kitchen_id = k.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE k.deleted = 0 GROUP BY k.id ORDER BY dishCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalDishes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS newDishes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cook_count > 0), 0) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0) AS cookedDishes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(collect_count > 0), 0) FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0) AS collectedDishes
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS num FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT d.id AS id, d.name AS name, d.cook_count AS cookCount, d.collect_count AS collectCount, d.rating AS rating, k.name AS kitchen FROM dish d JOIN kitchen k ON k.id = d.kitchen_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.cook_count > 0 ORDER BY d.cook_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS id, d.name AS name, d.collect_count AS collectCount, k.name AS kitchen FROM dish d JOIN kitchen k ON k.id = d.kitchen_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.collect_count > 0 ORDER BY d.collect_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cover IS NOT NULL AND cover != ''), 0) AS withCover, COALESCE(SUM(cover IS NULL OR cover = ''), 0) AS withoutCover FROM dish WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS newOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (3, 4) AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS doneInRange, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 3), 0) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS servedOrders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 4), 0) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS reviewedOrders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 5), 0) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS canceledOrders, (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(status IN (3, 4)), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(status != 5), 0), 1) FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS completionRate

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(status IN (3, 4)), 0) AS done FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT CASE time_period WHEN 1 THEN '早餐' WHEN 2 THEN '午餐' WHEN 3 THEN '晚餐' WHEN 4 THEN '宵夜' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS num FROM cook_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY time_period ORDER BY time_period

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating), 2), 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(SUM(rating = 5), 0) AS five, COALESCE(SUM(rating = 4), 0) AS four, COALESCE(SUM(rating <= 2), 0) AS low FROM cook_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS num, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0) AS avgRating FROM cook_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY dt
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS num FROM cook_review WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS totalOpened, COALESCE(SUM(expire_at > NOW()), 0) AS validMembers, COALESCE(SUM(tier = 1 AND expire_at > NOW()), 0) AS liteValid, COALESCE(SUM(tier = 2 AND expire_at > NOW()), 0) AS proValid, COALESCE(SUM(expire_at BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS expiringSoon FROM `member` WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS paidOrders, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS totalRevenue, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS avgOrder FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT DATE(paid_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS num, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS revenue FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND paid_at >= #{start} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(paid_at) ORDER BY dt

SELECT plan_code AS planCode, tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS num, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS revenue FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY plan_code, tier ORDER BY num DESC
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS refundOrders, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS refundAmount FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 2

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS createdOrders, COALESCE(SUM(status = 0), 0) AS pendingOrders, COALESCE(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS paidOrders, COALESCE(SUM(status = 2), 0) AS refundedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(status = 3), 0) AS closedOrders, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN actual_price ELSE 0 END) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS paidAmount FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT months, COUNT(*) AS num, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_price) / 100.0, 2), 0) AS revenue FROM member_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY months ORDER BY months
